Đèn bão còn dầu và vẫn cháy. Ai vừa thắp: The storm lantern still has oil and still burns. Who has just lit it... or has it never gone out?

Tớ mang theo ba mẩu báo: năm 1986 nhắc đ: I brought three newspaper clippings: 1986 mentions a rain-praying rite and Mr. Hưng; 1988 says the owner of Vân Hòa locked the gate and left; 1989 calls it an abandoned house. None names a source. The more I read, the more is missing.
Bà bán nước chỉ đường qua miếu, rồi nhìn: The tea seller pointed the way past the shrine, then looked at us a long time when she mentioned the house on the hill. I do not know what she feared. If only I had asked more, then.
Ở miếu ven rừng, tớ nhặt được mấy nén nh: At the shrine at the forest's edge I picked up a few unlit incense sticks. The slip under the incense bowl is still legible: “Five souls guard the gate, one shadow keeps the house.” Whether a warning or a riddle, I cannot tell. Hà went pale hearing it.
Chìa sắt vừa khít ổ khóa. Lúc cả nhóm bư: The iron key fitted the lock. As we all stepped through, the gate suddenly slammed shut. Khôi says hinges; Vũ swears no one touched it. I do not know which to believe, only that I jumped out of my skin.
Cửa chính không khóa. Khi đẩy, nó kêu dà: The main door was unlocked. When pushed, it groaned long, like someone letting out a breath. I tell myself old houses all do that, but once inside I keep glancing back at it.

Trong ảnh gia đình ông Hưng, một số khuô: In Mr. Hưng's family photograph several faces are scratched out. Chi looked a long time and did not want to take more pictures. Is it connected to 1988? Not enough evidence to say, but someone did not want the photograph kept whole.
Chiếc khăn vải mắc cạnh nắp giếng, cũ mà: A cloth scarf hung by the well cover, old but not yet rotted through. Hà thinks it may have been a servant's. I wrap it carefully; while we do not know whose it is, we should not call it unclaimed.

Sau khung ảnh có mảnh giấy thứ hai, giấu: Behind the photo frame is the second slip, hidden beneath a line of cipher. I keep it. Someone had to hide what they wanted to say this carefully.
Mảnh giấy thứ ba kẹp trong sổ vật tư của: The third slip was tucked in Mr. Hưng's supplies ledger. At last I have the chance to piece together what the writer meant to say.
Sổ vật tư năm 1988 có chữ ký ông Hưng: n: The 1988 supplies ledger bears Mr. Hưng's signature: candles, ritual paper and vent cloth issued to Master Chân. And a torn fragment of a request is tucked in the middle. I copy these entries exactly; I do not want to misremember a single word.
Ghép được ba mảnh đơn. Người viết nghi t: The three pieces of the request fit together. The writer suspects Master Chân of altering the ritual text and Mr. Hưng of concealing the issue of supplies. They asked whoever found the letter to pass it to the family. I read it over several times and keep choking up.
